company.shortDescription: Kamau Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company developing a new class of therapies to cure a range of serious and life-threatening diseases.
company.description: Kamau Therapeutics is a clinical-stage, next-generation gene correction company developing a new class of therapies to cure a range of serious and life-threatening diseases. The company's homology-directed repair (HDR), a novel gene correction approach, overcomes prior limitations in specificity, efficiency, and durability of gene editing to offer broad potential for transforming human health outcomes through the delivery of one-time curative cell therapies.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

aiResearchSummary.text: Kamau Therapeutics is developing compositions and methods for enhancing homology directed repair in gene editing by using improved peptide inhibitors of p fifty three binding protein fifty three B P one, alongside methods for genotyping gene edited hematopoietic stem cells using single cell RNA sequencing to assess editing outcomes in transplanted cell populations. Together these efforts focus on precise gene editing modulation and characterization of edited hematopoietic stem cells as key areas of research and development.
